# Snyk -- Reference
<!-- Generated By: Claude Code (Claude Opus 4.6) -->

## Overview

Developer security platform combining SCA, SAST, container scanning, and
IaC security [45]. Maintains a proprietary vulnerability database augmented
by research, ML, and human-in-the-loop AI [47]. Snyk is a CVE Numbering
Authority (CNA) [46].

## Vulnerability Database

Sources: public databases, community data, proprietary research, ML, and
human-in-the-loop AI [47].

**Vendor-reported claims (not independently verified):**
- 3x more vulnerabilities than next largest public database [46]
- 92% of JavaScript vulnerabilities reported before NVD [46]
- 47 days faster detection on average [46]

Two feeds: Application Feed (manually curated, code snippets) and Operating
System Feed (Linux vulnerabilities) [46].

## CLI

- Install: `npm install -g snyk` [45]
- `snyk auth` -- authenticate
- `snyk test` -- scan dependencies
- `snyk monitor` -- continuous monitoring (snapshots dependency tree) [45]

## Free Tier Limits

| Product | Monthly Tests |
|---------|--------------|
| Open Source (SCA) | 400 [42] |
| Code (SAST) | 100 [42] |
| IaC | 300 [42] |
| Container | 100 [42] |

Additional free tier details:
- Unlimited tests for public repositories [43]
- Private Registry Integrations not available [43]
- Free tier scope has been reduced multiple times [42]

## Open Source Program

All features with no usage limits for open source projects only [44].

## Paid Pricing

- Team plan: starts at $25/month per developer [42]
- Includes unlimited scans, custom rules, SSO, advanced reporting [42]

## Language Support

16+ languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Ruby,
PHP, C/C++, C#, VB.NET, Rust, Swift, Scala, Dart/Flutter, Apex [45].

## vs npm audit

- npm audit won't report vulnerabilities for non-semver versions [48]
- npm audit is CLI only vs Snyk multi-integration (CLI, IDE, Git, CI/CD) [48]
- Snyk reports vulnerabilities for packages npm audit may miss [48]

## Gaps and Limitations

- "3x" and "92%" database claims are self-reported marketing metrics [46]
- Free tier increasingly restrictive over time [42]
- Limited malware detection compared to Socket.dev [37]
- Paid plans can become cost-prohibitive for medium-sized businesses [42]
